name: HealthGraph Agent
description: Architecture and security rules for graph-backed code review.

adrs.title: ETL and iOS sync remain separate bounded contexts

decisions.summary: ETL must not import or call into the iOS sync layer
decisions.policy: Batch load jobs must not invoke mobile sync code paths.

incidents.title: Duplicate Neo4j writes after export handoff change
incidents.summary: A batch loader called the iOS sync push path directly, causing duplicate Day nodes and conflicting device metadata.

lessons.statement: Never call iOS sync routines from the Python ETL pipeline — use file-based handoff only.
lessons.recommends: Require platform/architecture review when etl/ and ios/ both change in one PR.

priorPullRequests.title: Wire mobile sync into nightly ETL job
priorPullRequests.summary: Introduced direct ETL → iOS coupling; reverted after duplicate graph writes in production.
